name: Replacement Processing Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the processing status of the replacement request.

EXCH.name: Received At Stock Exchange
EXCH.definition: Replacement request previously received from you has been received at the stock exchange.

INTE.name: Received At Intermediary
INTE.definition: Replacement request previously received from you has been received at intermediary (if not stock exchange).

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Replacement request has been accepted for further processing by the account servicer (technical receipt).

PART.name: Partial Replacement Accepted
PART.definition: Order is partially filled, replacement processing accepted for the remaining.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Replacement request has been rejected for further processing.

REPR.name: In Repair
REPR.definition: Replacement request previously received from you is in repair.
